import sys
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def num(x, nd=2):
    return round(float(x), nd)


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": float(value),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    for c in ["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW", "Revenue_LY", "Units_TW", "Units_LW",
              "Orders_TW", "Orders_LW", "WoW_Pct", "YoY_Pct", "Share_Pct", "Rank"]:
        if c not in df.columns:
            df[c] = np.nan
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    ly_mask = df["Revenue_LY"].notna()
    rev_ly = df.loc[ly_mask, "Revenue_LY"].sum()
    u_tw = df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    o_tw = df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)

    # TOTAL facts
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", num(rev_tw), "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", num(rev_lw), "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    if rev_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", num((rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if ly_mask.any() and rev_ly > 0:
        rev_tw_ly_rows = df.loc[ly_mask, "Revenue_TW"].sum()
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", num(rev_ly), "sum(Revenue_LY) over rows with LY data")
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", num((rev_tw_ly_rows - rev_ly) / rev_ly * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100 on rows with LY data")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", num(u_tw), "sum(Units_TW)")
    if u_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", num((u_tw - u_lw) / u_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", num(o_tw), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    if o_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", num((o_tw - o_lw) / o_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    # Top entities by revenue
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", num(r["Revenue_TW"]), "Revenue_TW for entity")
        if pd.notna(r["Share_Pct"]):
            add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", num(r["Share_Pct"], 1),
                "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
        if pd.notna(r["Rank"]):
            add(r["Entity"], "rank", "TW", num(r["Rank"], 0), "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")

    # Top 3 concentration
    if rev_tw > 0 and len(top) >= 3:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", num(top.head(3)["Revenue_TW"].sum() / rev_tw * 100, 1),
            "sum(top 3 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # WoW movers (absolute revenue change)
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    if len(d):
        d["delta"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
        up = d.sort_values("delta", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(up["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(up["delta"]),
            "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW (largest absolute gain)")
        dn = d.sort_values("delta").iloc[0]
        if dn["Entity"] != up["Entity"]:
            add(dn["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(dn["delta"]),
                "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW (largest absolute decline)")

    # WoW percent movers
    p = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct"]).copy()
    if len(p):
        hi = p.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(hi["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(hi["WoW_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (highest growth)")
        lo = p.sort_values("WoW_Pct").iloc[0]
        if lo["Entity"] != hi["Entity"]:
            add(lo["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(lo["WoW_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (largest decline)")

    # YoY movers
    y = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct"]).copy()
    if len(y):
        hi = y.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(hi["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(hi["YoY_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100 (highest growth)")
        lo = y.sort_values("YoY_Pct").iloc[0]
        if lo["Entity"] != hi["Entity"]:
            add(lo["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(lo["YoY_Pct"], 1),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100 (largest decline)")

    # Units and orders leaders
    uu = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"])
    if len(uu):
        ru = uu.sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(ru["Entity"], "units", "TW", num(ru["Units_TW"], 0), "Units_TW (highest)")
    oo = df.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"])
    if len(oo):
        ro = oo.sort_values("Orders_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(ro["Entity"], "orders", "TW", num(ro["Orders_TW"], 0), "Orders_TW (highest)")

    # Entities growing vs declining count
    if len(p):
        add("TOTAL", "share", "WoW", num((p["WoW_Pct"] > 0).sum() / len(p) * 100, 1),
            "count(WoW_Pct > 0) / count(WoW_Pct not null) * 100")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
